title: Nova First Contact
director_model: Claude 3.7 Sonnet / Antigravity AI Director Engine

brief.title: Nova First Contact
brief.user_prompt: Create a visually impressive, fully rendered 15-second 3D animated cinematic scene featuring a character named Nova interacting with a futuristic Quantum Core. Demonstrate real character modelling, rigging, animation, materials, object interaction, cinematic presentation and production orchestration.

character.name: Nova
character.description: Stylized athletic humanoid female explorer with recognizable anatomical proportions, sculpted head, torso, articulated arms with five-fingered hands, legs, and boots. Wearing futuristic field explorer uniform with armor plating, visor, and silk dynamic shoulder mantle.

color_palette.accessories: Graphite and brushed silver buckle and knee guards

rigging_requirements: 17-Bone skeletal armature (Root, Spine, Chest, Neck, Head, Limbs)
Dual 2-bone Inverse Kinematics (IK) on legs for walking stride and foot-planting
Dual 2-bone Inverse Kinematics (IK) on arms for reaching, touch contact, and bracing
Normalized vertex group deformation binding via Armature modifier
Dynamic cloth simulation for mantle pinned at chest shoulders

prop.name: Quantum Core
prop.description: Ancient harmonic energy artifact levitating above a cylindrical titanium pedestal. Features an inner luminous crystal, outer electric cyan energy shell, concentric counter-rotating gimbal rings, violet resonant corona, and 4 emitter struts with green/amber LED telemetry.

environment.name: Subterranean Quantum Research Vault
environment.description: High-tech subterranean containment laboratory featuring dark metallic carbon floor tiles with controlled reflections, illuminated electric cyan guide lines, architectural workstation pillars with glowing telemetry screens and status LEDs, central core pedestal, and energy deflector pillar.

lighting_setup.rim_light: 900W Warm Amber Spot Light (location: 0.0, 4.5, 4.5, focused on Nova and Core)

shots.name: The Discovery
shots.narrative_beat: Wide establishing shot. Nova enters the futuristic laboratory along the cyan guide runner, surveying the subterranean facility. The glowing Quantum Core is discovered in the center. Nova turns her head and upper torso towards the Core in wonder and scientific curiosity.

character_animation.locomotion: Walks along Y from -5.5 to -3.2 using Foot_IK stride, swaying torso, turning head +0.18 rad toward Core at frame 60
character_animation.gesture: Right arm balances stride; dynamic silk cape flutters in ventilation airflow
character_animation.facial_expression: NEUTRAL transitioning to FOCUSED curiosity; involuntary eye blinks at frame 45 and 95

shots.name: First Contact
shots.narrative_beat: Medium-close tracking shot. Nova approaches the Core pedestal and decelerates to a stop at y=-1.2. She raises her right arm, extends her hand, and delicately makes physical contact with the outer gimbal ring of the Quantum Core at frame 210 (t=8.75s).

character_animation.locomotion: Decelerates from y=-3.2 to y=-1.2 by frame 160, plants feet firmly in grounded stance (Foot_IK)
character_animation.gesture: Right arm (Hand_IK.R) elevates from hip at frame 170 and extends forward to reach (0.0, -0.44, 1.30) making direct physical contact with the Core at frame 210
character_animation.facial_expression: FOCUSED alert frown (Alert_Frown=0.70); natural eyelid blinks at frame 150

shots.name: Energy Response
shots.narrative_beat: Hero composition. In response to Nova's physical contact, the Quantum Core flares with bright cyan/blue luminescence! Gimbal rings spin into high-speed gyroscopic rotation, and a resonant violet corona expands. Nova absorbs the energy glow, torso recoils slightly, and her face transitions into a resolute, victorious smile beside the humming Core.

character_animation.locomotion: Grounded hero stance at y=-1.30, chest elevated +0.12 rad, head tilted proudly observing the stabilized core
character_animation.gesture: Right hand gently retracts to side; dynamic mantle drapes softly as kinetic surge settles
character_animation.facial_expression: Alert_Frown drops to 0.0; Smile ramps to 0.85 by frame 290 and holds; blinks at frame 310

dialogue.speaker: NOVA
dialogue.text: Subterranean sector reached. Visual contact with the Quantum Core.
